## Description

Go-live runbook (roles, timeline, fallback, comms), migration report handed over, training delivered, cut-over during clinic hours with parallel run, hypercare for two weeks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The clinic does not close for the switch; fallback was available until sign-off (exit gate 1).
- [ ] **AC2.** Migration report and go-live runbook delivered (delivery package 2).
- [ ] **AC3.** Hypercare issues tracked to closure with the clinic.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
